title: [Bug 647233] Fix User Confirmed copied into Canceled when posting expense report lines
summary: Fixed a data corruption bug where the User Confirmed field from expense report lines was being incorrectly copied into the Canceled field of posted expense report lines during posting, by introducing a new non-colliding field and adding data migration logic.
key_points: Field 92 is User Confirmed on Expense Report Line but Canceled on Posted Expense Report Line, so TransferFields copied confirmation into Canceled
Canceled (field 92) is obsoleted as Pending and replaced by new field 94 Is Canceled
Cancel Posted Expense Report now uses Is Canceled
Upgrade code in UpgradeExpenseAgentSetup migrates existing Canceled data to the new field
Regression test checks that posting a confirmed line does not mark the posted line canceled
